Our Story

Made In India,
Worn Worldwide.

🚀 GITHUB PE PUBLISH KARO

Products add/edit karne ke baad yeh button dabao → index.html download hogi → GitHub repo mein replace karo → Sab devices pe dikh jaayega! 🎉

📋 Steps:
1. Upar button dabao → file download hogi
2. GitHub.com → repo open karo
3. index.html → Edit (pencil icon)
4. Ctrl+A → Delete → Downloaded file ka content paste karo
5. Commit changes → 2 min mein live! ✅
